name: FrontierCS 2
protocol: Official FrontierCS 2 leaderboard; 48 public tasks, one five-hour run per task, each agent in its own vendor harness; pass rate is passing runs divided by 48.

summary.en: Tests whether coding agents can deliver open-ended computer-science R&D results inside a real research repository.
summary.zh: 测试 coding agent 能否在真实研究代码仓库中完成开放式计算机科学研发任务。

task_format.en: 48 public tasks across 13 domains such as ML systems, HPC, databases, security and robotics; the agent inherits a working repository, works for up to five hours, and submits a patch.
task_format.zh: 48 个公开任务覆盖 ML 系统、HPC、数据库、安全和机器人等 13 个领域；agent 接手一个可运行的代码仓库，最多工作五小时，然后提交补丁。

explanation.en: Share of the 48 task runs whose final submission passes the hidden-reference judge. The FCI capability index on the leaderboard is a separate IRT scale and is not used here.
explanation.zh: 48 个任务运行中，最终提交通过隐藏参考答案评审的比例。榜单上的 FCI 能力指数是另一种 IRT 量表，这里不使用。
